assessment: GO for deterministic S1 stable-home semantics and one isolated real graphical Minecraft qualification of the tested S1/M0 lifecycle

semantic_contract.S1 relative: ordered execution-time capture of the current bound player's position
semantic_contract.repeated S1 relative: every distinct executed assignment captures a new home
semantic_contract.S1 absolute: global world coordinates, no movement or homing
semantic_contract.S1 toggle: entering relative homes; entering absolute does not
semantic_contract.scope: home persists across programs, requests, WebSocket frames and reconnects for the same validated BCL session/actor
semantic_contract.voxel_coordinates: floor of the same captured position, matching existing integer block-position contracts

architecture.execution_path: existing compiler -> typed IR -> ModalSession -> BCLJobs FIFO -> AgentRuntime -> existing skills/native player
architecture.home_timing: runtime only, never compilation or async enqueue
architecture.ordering: one explicit observation barrier per executed home
architecture.persistence: private SessionStore journal with mode, home revision/status, exact home, voxel origin, dimension and existing world/player/actor identities
architecture.deduplication: same request ID/source returns cached outcome and never re-homes

failure_contract.cancelled_or_failed_pending_home: previous active coordinate context restored when applicable
failure_contract.actor_or_player_mismatch: existing AgentRuntime actor fences stop before homing

compatibility.impact: intentional incompatible correction of the former fresh-per-operation relative interpretation
compatibility.old_journals: fail closed and require a new session ID
compatibility.registry_digest: changed through explicit coordinate metadata and S1 command metadata
compatibility.historical_evidence: docs/evidence/bcl-live.json retained unchanged and not relabelled

native_graphical_client.client: Real graphical Minecraft 26.3 through the installed isolated Prism instance
native_graphical_client.scope: Authenticated native TLS bridge -> authenticated BCL TLS gateway -> existing BCLJobs FIFO/AgentRuntime -> native M0 movement; no teleport, cheat, second controller or replay path
native_graphical_client.privacy: UUID, actor token, absolute coordinates, credentials, private keys and raw observations remain only in ignored private build artifacts and are excluded from bundles.
native_graphical_client.qualification_limit: This run qualifies the tested S1 lifecycle and four M0 movement legs only; it does not qualify other coordinate adapters, crafting, combat or an external objective.
native_graphical_client.historical_runs: The older real-client relative runs used the superseded semantics and remain separate historical evidence.

release_state: No commit, push, tag, upload, release or deployment performed.
